title: URL Shortener API
description: A RESTful service for creating short links and redirecting them. Redirects use the Cache-Aside pattern with Redis, which takes read load off the database and keeps latency low.

title: 19wpm
description: A Monkeytype-inspired typing platform with JWT auth (including token blocklisting) and GitHub and Google OAuth2 login. Multiplayer race mode runs on WebSockets/STOMP with Redis-backed ephemeral state, containerized and deployed on Azure Container Apps.

title: PharmaTrack
description: A pharmacy management system covering medicine inventory, sales transactions and customer records, with 20+ REST endpoints.

title: Relay
description: Real-time chat application with a Spring Boot WebSocket/STOMP backend, JWT-authenticated handshakes, presence tracking, and a React/TypeScript frontend.

title: LSRS
description: Gown and suit rental management system with a reservation lifecycle, deposit and invoice workflows, and PHPUnit feature tests.

title: MalVote
description: Android APK malware classifier using a soft-voting ensemble, 96.05% accuracy across 5 threat classes, with a FastAPI backend and React dashboard.
